D12b-contract.detail: The Windows runner contract matches the Linux runner. It dispatches wsl.exe --distribution <d> --user root --exec bash <repo>/scripts/shells/linux/debian/install_shells/docker_model_runner.sh <action> <model> <wslStaging> with argument arrays (DockerWslBridge.ps1:480). It keeps only RESULT lines whose action and model match, and it passes only on PASS with exit 0 (:484-497). It prints runner_printed_no_result_line when none match (:494). The restart-required token re-runs ensure once (:555-559), which matches Linux _tts_docker_wsl_systemd_ensure. Only <MODEL>_DEVICE is forwarded, through WSLENV for the one call (:471-483). The model.sh read has no regex: in-process Get-DockerModelDefinition returns 16 keys for melotts (HOST_FREE_RAM_GB 4.5, EST_DISK_GB 6) and 16 for fishspeech (6.0, 7), and the empty MODEL_CONTEXT_ASSETS parses to ''.

D12b-wsl-debian13.detail: Initialize-DockerModelWslDistro (DockerWslBridge.ps1:361-430) compares VERSION_ID to the string '13' and imports a side-by-side Debian13 into WSL_DISK_DIR\debian13, which does not collide with WSL_DEBIAN_DISK_DIR\debian. It never unregisters a distro, never runs --set-default and never touches .wslconfig. The .wslconfig caps are unchanged (memory=6GB, swap=8GB, processors=4), and wsl -l -v still shows the default Ubuntu-24.04 with Debian stopped. Step29 now merges [user] default=root through Set-WslConfKey instead of overwriting /etc/wsl.conf, which used to drop [boot] systemd=true. It also terminates only the changed distros instead of running wsl --shutdown (Step29:532-555). Step30 -DistroName/-InstallDir and its non-interactive defaults are correct (Step30:1-25, 248-251, 328-331, 530, 563, 573-577).

D12b-step55-56.detail: The wiring works (ensure, then an optional bounded test, a message and return instead of exit 1, the backend saved only after a PASS). But the docker branch bypasses the steps' opt-in gate, and the Step56 default flip extends that to Fish Speech on every fresh Windows pyservice boot (B1).

D12b-release.detail: Releasing after test/up -Release terminates the distro even when it was already running before the call (B2).

D12b-wrappers.detail: Invoke-TtsDockerEnsure and Invoke-TtsDockerApply now route to the runner, which needs model.sh. No model.sh exists for cosyvoice or gptsovits, so their docker branches on both platforms regress to a certain FAIL (B3).

blocking_issues: B1 (pycore-ai): the docker branch ignores the opt-in gate. Step56_InstallFishspeech.ps1:10 promises 'Opt-in: -Full or FISHSPEECH_INSTALL=1 or NEURAL_TTS_INSTALL=1'. Step55_InstallMelotts.ps1:4 and :17-19 say 'Status-only by default ... so an unattended pyservice boot never spends minutes building it unrequested'. But the docker branch (Step55:112-125, Step56:88-100) runs Invoke-DockerModelRunner ensure before $doFull (Step55:55, Step56:36) is consulted. Step56 now defaults to docker (:84-86). pyservice.ps1 run (the default, without -NoInstall; pyservice.ps1:423-452) runs PreparePycorePrerequisites.ps1, which passes -Full only for -Full or NEURAL_TTS_INSTALL=1 (:88-99), and a fresh host has no saved method. So on a fresh host, each pyservice boot does the heavy ensure unattended: a possible Step30 Debian import, the Docker Engine install, a multi-GB image build and the weights. Fix: when neither $doFull nor $Force is set, the docker branch reports status only and makes no WSL call. It prints the saved TTS_<ENGINE>_BACKEND and TTS_DOCKER_PROVIDER_STATE plus the opt-in hint, then returns. ensure and the optional test run only when opted in. Mirror this in Linux 139_install_melotts.sh:36-47,66-67 and 143_install_fishspeech.sh:48-59,80-81 (DO_FULL), and update SPW-014 in both ledgers.

B2 (pycore-ai): DockerWslBridge.ps1:533 sets $terminateAfter = $releaseAfter -or (...). So test (and up -Release) run wsl --terminate on the distro in the finally block (:568-570) even when $runningBefore shows it was already running. Any sessions, containers or services the user had in that distro are killed without approval. The restart-required branch (:555-558) also terminates a distro that was running before. Fix: terminate only a distro this call started, i.e. ($runningBefore -notcontains $distroName) -and ($releaseAfter -or $Action -ne 'up'). When the distro was already running, the release is the runner down only, with a log line saying the distro was left running. In the restart branch, a pre-running distro is not terminated: report SKIP restart-required and ask the user to terminate it. Update SPW-009 and SPW-011.

B3 (pycore-ai): the wrapper regression for cosyvoice and gptsovits. Invoke-TtsDockerEnsure and Invoke-TtsDockerApply (DockerWslBridge.ps1:574-592) now call the runner. The runner fails with FAIL model_definition_missing (tts_docker_compose_common.sh:146-150) because scripts/shells/docker_compose/tts/{cosyvoice,gptsovits}/ has no model.sh. The Windows docker branches in Step52_InstallCosyVoice.ps1:76-88 and Step54_InstallGptsovits.ps1:128-140 fail every time and still exit 1 (:80,:85 and :132,:137). So do the Linux 133_install_cosyvoice.sh:61-69 and 137_install_gptsovits.sh:83-85 (tts_docker_apply_engine). The base ran those through ensure_docker_for_tts.sh plus compose apply. SPW-007 defers this to a follow-up that is not in TASKS.md. Fix, recommended: add model.sh for cosyvoice (port 50000) and gptsovits (port 9880) in the plain KEY=value form, with MODEL_WEIGHTS_METHOD, MODEL_HEALTH_PATH and model_smoke. Move their compose.yml onto the runner env (TTS_MEM_LIMIT/TTS_CPUS/TTS_PIDS_LIMIT, the pycore.fingerprint build label), as melotts did. Pass -StagingDir $targetDir to Invoke-TtsDockerEnsure in Step52:78 and Step54:130; they currently stage into the default dir while apply uses COSYVOICE_DIR/GPTSOVITS_DIR. Replace exit 1 with a message and return, as in Step55/56. Acceptable interim alternative if model.sh cannot land in G3: remove 'docker' from SupportedBackends in Step52/54 and 133/137 until it does.

DockerWslBridge.ps1:528-532 returns before the try/finally, so a distro started by Get-WslDistroVersionId on a failed Initialize path (VERSION_ID not 13, then the side import fails) stays running. Apply the same started-by-this-call terminate rule on that path.
Set-WslConfKey (DockerWslBridge.ps1:315) creates a missing /etc/wsl.conf with cp from drvfs, so the mode follows drvfs (usually 0755). Use install -m 0644, or chmod 0644 after creating it.
